meta.title: Where Ontario’s rivers end
meta.method: Only river geometry inside Ontario is animated. Each connected visible network starts simultaneously at zero from its downstream shore or border crossing, with one common kilometres-per-second rate. Outside-region routes are retained only for the fact annotation, never the fill or its distance clock. Bars measure the mapped network length inside the region, including hidden lake connections. HydroRIVERS is generalized and omits many small streams and engineered diversions.
meta.systemColorMethod: Colors follow connected receiving-water tributary networks. Named nested branches receive their own color throughout their upstream subnetwork; stable outlet-derived shades distinguish smaller unnamed networks.
meta.farthestDefinition: In-Ontario connected river distance from the downstream receiving-water shore or provincial border crossing to the headwater. No distance outside the region is included.
meta.animationDistanceDefinition: Each contiguous in-Ontario drainage component starts at zero at its downstream receiving-water shore or provincial border crossing. One linear distance counter controls every component; no outside-region segment or distance participates in the fill.
meta.sourceDistanceCorrectionDefinition: sourceD0/sourceD1 preserve the inherited network model. clockD0/clockD1 add sourceDistanceCorrectionKm where an inherited receiving-mainstem zero omitted an in-province river approach; regional distances subtract only the corrected component origin.

last.distanceDefinition: In-Ontario connected river distance from the downstream receiving-water shore or provincial border crossing to the headwater. No distance outside the region is included.
last.label: Farthest in-region headwater

sources.title: Natural Earth 1:10m boundaries, land, lakes and river names

ontarioLongest.distanceDefinition: Complete receiving-water-shore-to-headwater river route within Ontario, measured only along the strictly displayed in-region geometry. Routes beginning at a foreign-land border do not qualify.
ontarioLongest.label: Farthest in-region headwater

eligibility.definition: True complete river headwater; no foreign-land crossing. Displayed route is cropped to the exact provincial polygon and remeasured from its strict visible shore endpoint. The earlier shoreline-model length is provenance only.

outsideRouteFact.label: Farthest upstream headwater
outsideRouteFact.routeNote: Actual downstream HydroRIVERS links, including travel outside Ontario. Context route is excluded from Ontario length shares.
outsideRouteFact.distanceDefinition: Full downstream-network distance to the external receiving water. This route and its outside distance are excluded from the regional fill.
outsideRouteFact.routeDescription: Reaches Hudson Bay via the Rainy–Winnipeg–Nelson system

ontarioLongestProvenance.distanceDefinition: River-network distance from the Ontario receiving-water shore to the farthest headwater whose complete landward route remains in Ontario.

eligibility.definition: Complete coast/receiving-water-to-headwater route remains in Ontario within 1 km cartographic tolerance; only a receiving-water shoreline prefix may be excluded, never another province or country.
